nuggets.text: Cam Little owns the longest field goal in NFL history: 68 yards at Las Vegas on November 2, 2025.
Cam Little also drilled a 70-yard field goal in a 2025 preseason game against the Steelers.
Travis Hunter was the first player to win both the Bednarik Award (top defender) and the Biletnikoff Award (top receiver).
The Jaguars landed Travis Hunter with the second pick of the 2025 draft in a trade with the Browns.
Josh Hines-Allen was Josh Allen until 2024, when he changed his name to honor his sisters and uncles.
Josh Hines-Allen is the Jaguars' all-time sack leader, passing Tony Brackens' 55 in November 2025.
In 2025 Trevor Lawrence became the first NFL player with five-plus TD passes, a rushing TD and 50-plus rushing yards in one game.
Liam Coen holds six of the eight career passing records at UMass, where he wore No. 12 in honor of Tom Brady.
EverBank Stadium has two pools in the north end zone, with cabana seating alongside.
The Jaguars reached the AFC Championship Game in 1996, their second season, the youngest expansion team ever to get there.
